description: Full record for one named or selected residency, visa or citizenship program. Returns a canonical summary plus sourced requirements, income or investment minimum, stay rules, permanent-residency and citizenship timelines, government fees, processing time, legal basis and verification dates. Use search_programs or find_visas to identify a program first; pass its program_id for the most precise match.

program.description: A program_id such as "panama-friendly-nations-visa", or part of a program name such as "Paraguay investor".
